data.text:
2/15/1898 A massive explosion of unknown origin sinks the battleship USS Maine in Cuba's Havana harbor, killing more than 260 members of the 350-plus American crew members on board. One of the first US battleships, the Maine weighed more than 6,000 tons and was built at a cost of $2M. The Maine was sent there to protect the interest of Americans there after a rebellion against Spanish rule broke out in Havana. A official US Naval Court of Inquiry ruled the ship was blown up by a mine, without putting the blame directly on Spain. Much of Congress and the majority of the American public expressed little doubt Spain was to blame and wanted to declare war. This, and the effect on American interests in Cuba led to the Spanish-American War in 1898. Within 3 months, the United States had decisively defeated Spain on land and sea. On Dec 12th, 1898, the Treaty of Paris officially ended the Spanish-American War and granted the United States it's first overseas empire with the ceding of Spanish territories of Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines. In 1976,a team of American naval investigators concluded that the explosion was likely caused by a fire that ignited its ammunition stocks, not by a mine or sabotage. Still, it was a case of FAFO! 🇺🇲
